title: COMEX vs. Physical Silver Prices (August 9, 2026)
takeaway: The COMEX silver futures price is significantly higher than the spot price for physical silver due to market speculation and other factors.

data.label: COMEX Futures Price
data.evidence: As of today, August 9, 2026, the COMEX silver futures price is approximately $35.20 per ounce.

data.label: Spot Price for Physical Silver
data.evidence: The spot price for physical silver is around $28.70 per ounce.

data.label: Spread
data.evidence: This spread is influenced by various factors, including market volatility and inventory levels.

narration: The COMEX silver futures price, reflecting speculative trading, is considerably higher than the current spot price for physical silver. This difference is driven by a combination of factors, including market sentiment, futures contract mechanics, and the costs associated with storing and transporting physical silver. Understanding this spread is crucial for investors evaluating their silver holdings.
